mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized growth > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2%, the combination signals a disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL < 2% does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease over the past 3 months, the combination signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS decrease does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase > 5% does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases over the past 3 months, the combination signals a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of GDPC1 growth < 1% and INDPRO decrease does not correlate with negative returns (p > 0.05).
